name: Source list → Documents
description: AUX-COMPLETE (DP-61): map a bibliographic source list (xlsx) into DocumentNodes — the Documents sheet of em_data. The ID column identifies each source (a DocumentNode); TITLE is carried as a property. The RICH bibliographic fields (FILENAME / YEAR / AUTHOR_IDS / ROLE / CONTENT_NATURE / GEOMETRY) map to DocumentNode attributes, whose schema extension is DP-58 — left to E.D.; for now only ID + TITLE are mapped, the rest is a declared follow-up.

ID.description: Stable identifier of the source document.
